description: The plot illustrates the relationship between Initial Confidence and Accuracy, showing three distinct lines representing different aspects of accuracy. The x-axis, labeled "Initial Confidence", has a linear scale, ranging from 0.95 to 0.99 with a tick label interval of 0.01. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy", also has a linear scale, spanning from 0.0 to 1.0 with a tick label interval of 0.2. The blue solid line with diamond markers represents a trend that starts at approximately 0.88 at an Initial Confidence of 0.95, remains relatively stable until 0.98 where it peaks at around 0.89, and then slightly decreases to about 0.86 at 0.99. The orange dashed line with diamond markers begins at around 0.88 at 0.95 Initial Confidence, gradually decreases to approximately 0.85 at 0.965, remains steady until 0.98, and then drops to about 0.73 at 0.99. The green dashed-dotted line with square markers starts near 0.0 at 0.95 Initial Confidence and increases to around 0.12 at 0.99. Error bars are present for all three lines, indicating variability in the data.
